# crypto_jwks (Data Source)

Reads a JSON Web Key Set (JWKS) and exposes its contents

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crypto_jwks" "example" {
  jwks = file("${path.module}/jwks.json")
}

output "keys" {
  value     = data.crypto_jwks.example.keys
  sensitive = true
}

# Extract specific key information
output "key_ids" {
  value = [for key in data.crypto_jwks.example.keys : key.key_id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `jwks` (String, Sensitive) JWKS JSON content to read

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier
- `keys` (Attributes List) List of keys extracted from the JWKS (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--keys))

<a id="nestedatt--keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `keys`

Read-Only:

- `algorithm` (String) Algorithm (alg)
- `certificate_chain` (List of String) List of PEM-encoded certificates from the x5c field
- `key_id` (String) Key ID (kid)
- `key_type` (String) Key type (RSA or EC)
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) PEM-encoded private key (if available)
- `public_key` (String) PEM-encoded public key
- `use` (String) Public key use (sig or enc)
